**Date:** November 4, 2026

**WonderSuite** is Alice's comprehensive AI safety platform designed to help organizations secure, evaluate, and protect their AI systems throughout the entire lifecycle. It provides an integrated set of tools that enable teams to proactively identify vulnerabilities, enforce safety policies, and maintain compliance across all generative AI applications.

WonderSuite brings together two core products under a unified platform:

- **WonderBuild** — An automated red teaming engine that stress-tests AI systems to uncover safety vulnerabilities before they reach production.
- **WonderFence** — A real-time guardrails platform that monitors, detects, and enforces policy-compliant behavior in live AI applications.

Together, these products form a closed-loop safety workflow: discover risks with WonderBuild, then mitigate them with WonderFence.

**How to use this guide:**

1. Start with **[Application Inventory](https://docs.alice.io/wondersuite/application-inventory)** to register the AI applications and versions you want to govern.
2. Use **[WonderBuild](https://docs.alice.io/wondersuite/wonderbuild/introducing-wonderbuild)** to run red-teaming assessments against application versions, review reports, and iterate on findings.
3. Use **[WonderFence](https://docs.alice.io/wondersuite/wonderfence/introducing-wonderfence)** to configure real-time enforcement policies, route live traffic through guardrails, and investigate detected violations.
4. Use **[Account Settings](https://docs.alice.io/wondersuite/account-settings/roles-and-permissions)** to manage roles, users, and platform configuration.
